properties.statement: Every integer calendar output is in its §9.8 range: month 1..12, day 1..(days in that month) ⊆ 1..31, hour 0..23, minute 0..59, second 0..59, day_of_year 1..(days in that year) ⊆ 1..366, is_leap_year 0 or 1.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ t : ℝ, (1 ≤ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.month.exact t) ∧ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.month.exact t) ≤ 12) ∧ (1 ≤ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.day.exact t) ∧ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.day.exact t) ≤ Esm.Closed.Datetime.monthLength (Esm.Closed.Datetime.isLeapYear (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.year.exact t)) (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.month.exact t) ∧ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.day.exact t) ≤ 31) ∧ (0 ≤ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.hour.exact t) ∧ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.hour.exact t) ≤ 23) ∧ (0 ≤ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.minute.exact t) ∧ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.minute.exact t) ≤ 59) ∧ (0 ≤ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.second.exact t) ∧ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.second.exact t) ≤ 59) ∧ (1 ≤ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.dayOfYear.exact t) ∧ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.dayOfYear.exact t) ≤ Esm.Closed.Datetime.yearLength (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.year.exact t) ∧ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.dayOfYear.exact t) ≤ 366) ∧ ((Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.isLeapYear.exact t) = 0 ∨ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.isLeapYear.exact t) = 1)

properties.statement: The floor-divmod by 86400: t = 86400·⌊t/86400⌋ + tod with 0 ≤ tod < 86400 (Python-style floored modulo).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ t : ℝ, t = 86400 * (Esm.Closed.Datetime.dayNumber t : ℝ) + Esm.Closed.Datetime.timeOfDay t ∧ 0 ≤ Esm.Closed.Datetime.timeOfDay t ∧ Esm.Closed.Datetime.timeOfDay t < 86400

properties.statement: The decomposition round-trips to the real instant floor: 86400·days(year, month, day) + 3600·hour + 60·minute + second = ⌊t⌋ (hour/minute/second from ⌊time-of-day⌋, ruling Q-3).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ t : ℝ, 86400 * Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil ⟨(Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.year.exact t), (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.month.exact t), (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.day.exact t)⟩ + 3600 * (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.hour.exact t) + 60 * (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.minute.exact t) + (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.second.exact t) = ⌊t⌋

properties.statement: civil-from-days and days-from-civil are inverse: every day number maps to a valid date and back, and every valid date maps to a day number and back.
properties.lean_statement: (∀ n : ℤ, Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil (Esm.Closed.Datetime.civilFromDays n) = n ∧ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.civilFromDays n).Valid) ∧ ∀ c : Esm.Closed.Datetime.Date, c.Valid → Esm.Closed.Datetime.civilFromDays (Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil c) = c

properties.statement: The day count is the proleptic-Gregorian calendar: day 0 is 1970-01-01; consecutive days, months of the standard lengths (February 28/29), and years of 365 days, or 366 when divisible by 4 and not by 100 unless by 400, follow one another with no gaps.
properties.lean_statement: Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil ⟨1970, 1, 1⟩ = 0 ∧ (∀ y m d : ℤ, Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil ⟨y, m, d + 1⟩ = Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil ⟨y, m, d⟩ + 1) ∧ (∀ y m : ℤ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ 11 → Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil ⟨y, m + 1, 1⟩ = Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil ⟨y, m, Esm.Closed.Datetime.monthLength (Esm.Closed.Datetime.isLeapYear y) m⟩ + 1) ∧ (∀ y : ℤ, Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil ⟨y + 1, 1, 1⟩ = Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil ⟨y, 12, 31⟩ + 1) ∧ (∀ (l : Bool) (m : ℤ), Esm.Closed.Datetime.monthLength l m = if m = 2 then (if l then 29 else 28) else if m = 4 ∨ m = 6 ∨ m = 9 ∨ m = 11 then 30 else 31) ∧ (∀ y : ℤ, Esm.Closed.Datetime.yearLength y = if (4 ∣ y ∧ ¬ 100 ∣ y) ∨ 400 ∣ y then 366 else 365)

properties.statement: is_leap_year(t) = 1 exactly when the year of t has 366 days, exactly when it has a February 29, and exactly when the year is divisible by 4 and not by 100, or by 400.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ t : ℝ, ((Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.isLeapYear.exact t) = 1 ↔ Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil ⟨(Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.year.exact t) + 1, 1, 1⟩ - Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil ⟨(Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.year.exact t), 1, 1⟩ = 366) ∧ ((Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.isLeapYear.exact t) = 1 ↔ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.Date.Valid ⟨(Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.year.exact t), 2, 29⟩)) ∧ ((Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.isLeapYear.exact t) = 1 ↔ (4 ∣ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.year.exact t) ∧ ¬ 100 ∣ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.year.exact t)) ∨ 400 ∣ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.year.exact t))

properties.statement: day_of_year agrees with month and day (days before the month plus the day) and counts from January 1 of the same year (1 = Jan 1).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ t : ℝ, (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.dayOfYear.exact t) = Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysBeforeMonth (Esm.Closed.Datetime.isLeapYear (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.year.exact t)) (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.month.exact t) + (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.day.exact t) ∧ (Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.dayOfYear.exact t) = Esm.Closed.Datetime.dayNumber t - Esm.Closed.Datetime.daysFromCivil ⟨(Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn.year.exact t), 1, 1⟩ + 1

properties.statement: The integer outputs are monotone in t: t ≤ t' implies (year, month, day, hour, minute, second) at t is lexicographically ≤ the same at t'.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ t t' : ℝ, t ≤ t' → Esm.Closed.Datetime.fieldsKey t ≤ Esm.Closed.Datetime.fieldsKey t'

properties.statement: For every t, the spec's reference julian_day equals the standard Julian Date t/86400 + 2440587.5 (JD 0 = noon UTC on 4713 BC Jan 1, proleptic Julian).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ t : ℝ, Esm.Closed.Datetime.julianDay t = t / 86400 + 2440587.5
properties.note: Ruling Q-99 (2026-10-26): julian_day is the standard Julian Date for every t; Esm.Closed.Datetime.julianDay is now the exact value of the expression §9.2 pins, (d + 2440588) + (tod − 43200)/86400. The Fliegel–van Flandern computation is §9.2's informative note (Esm.Closed.Datetime.fvfJulianDay), which is NOT the Julian Date before -4800-03-01 (Esm.Closed.Datetime.fvfJulianDay_ne_standard). Fixtures: tests/closed_functions/datetime/julian_day/expected.json scenarios jd_* and frac_*minus_4800*.

properties.statement: On the lib/calendar.esm template domain |t| < 2^52 the year of t is a signed 32-bit integer, so every integer calendar function returns its exact value there.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (f : Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntFn) (t : ℝ), |t| < (2 : ℝ) ^ (52 : ℕ) → f.eval t = Esm.Closed.Datetime.IntResult.ok (f.exact t)

properties.statement: Howard Hinnant's civil_from_days (eras of 146097 days, March-based years, floor divisions), as lib/calendar.esm computes it, is the model's proleptic-Gregorian civilFromDays for every day number.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℤ), Esm.Closed.Datetime.hinnant n = Esm.Closed.Datetime.civilFromDays n

properties.statement: searchsorted returns the least 1-based k with xs[k] ≥ x, or N+1; so its result is in [1, N+1] (and fits Int32 for N < 2^31 − 1).

properties.statement: A NaN query returns N+1, whatever xs holds.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (xs : List Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.searchsorted Esm.Closed.Num.nan xs = xs.length + (1 : ℕ)

properties.statement: searchsorted is monotone in x, with NaN above every real.

properties.statement: Q-6: for doubles t, u and any w ∈ [0, 1], the pinned blend t ⊕ (w ⊗ (u ⊖ t)) and the FMA blend fma(w, u ⊖ t, t) differ by at most 2·ulp(max(|t|, |u|)).

properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy : ℝ), Esm.F64.Repr t00 → Esm.F64.Repr t10 → Esm.F64.Repr t01 → Esm.F64.Repr t11 → (0 : ℝ) ≤ wx → wx ≤ (1 : ℝ) → (0 : ℝ) ≤ wy → wy ≤ (1 : ℝ) → have M := Max.max (Max.max |t00| |t10|) (Max.max |t01| |t11|); |Esm.Closed.Rounding.bilinear64 t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy - Esm.Closed.Rounding.bilinearR t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy| ≤ (11 / 2 : ℝ) * Esm.F64.ulp M ∧ |Esm.Closed.Rounding.bilinearFMA t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy - Esm.Closed.Rounding.bilinearR t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy| ≤ (3 : ℝ) * Esm.F64.ulp M

properties.statement: Q-6 for the reference bilinear: the all-FMA and the pinned evaluations differ by at most 17/2·ulp(max |corner|).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy : ℝ), Esm.F64.Repr t00 → Esm.F64.Repr t10 → Esm.F64.Repr t01 → Esm.F64.Repr t11 → (0 : ℝ) ≤ wx → wx ≤ (1 : ℝ) → (0 : ℝ) ≤ wy → wy ≤ (1 : ℝ) → |Esm.Closed.Rounding.bilinear64 t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy - Esm.Closed.Rounding.bilinearFMA t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy| ≤ (17 / 2 : ℝ) * Esm.F64.ulp (Max.max (Max.max |t00| |t10|) (Max.max |t01| |t11|))

properties.statement: The lib/interp.esm searchsorted template 1 + count(not(xs[k] >= x)) over k in [1, n], n = |xs|, equals the reference searchsorted for every query (NaN included) on a non-decreasing xs, at every scalar type with real values and one NaN (exact Num, binary64 Bin64).

properties.statement: Key lemma for the templates: on a non-decreasing real axis of n ≥ 2 knots, min(max(count(axis[k] <= q), 1), n - 1) is one more (1-based) than the reference's 0-based cell, for every real query.

properties.statement: The template's cell index is §9.8's: on a strictly increasing axis and a query in [a_1, a_n], the 1-based i lies in [1, n−1] with a_i ≤ q < a_{i+1}, or q is the last knot and i = n − 1.

properties.statement: Interior-knot convention of the templates: a query exactly on 0-based knot k with a knot after it gets the 1-based cell index k + 1 (weight 0).

properties.statement: The lib/interp.esm linear template equals the reference linear for every table and every query (NaN included) on a non-decreasing axis of n ≥ 2 knots (so on every strictly increasing one), at every scalar type with real values and one NaN; at Bin64 this is bit-for-bit binary64 equality.

properties.statement: The lib/interp.esm bilinear template equals the reference bilinear for every table and every query (NaN in either coordinate included) on non-decreasing axes of at least two knots each, at every scalar type with real values and one NaN; at Bin64 this is bit-for-bit binary64 equality.

properties.lean_statement: ∀ (c n : ℕ), (1 : ℕ) ≤ n → n ≤ (2 : ℕ) ^ (53 : ℕ) → Min.min (Max.max (c : ℝ) (1 : ℝ)) (Esm.F64.fsub (n : ℝ) (1 : ℝ)) = ((Min.min (Max.max c (1 : ℕ)) (n - (1 : ℕ)) : ℕ) : ℝ)

properties.statement: A ring with vertex j (1 <= j <= n) repeated right after itself is the ring with a zero-length edge inserted at edge position j (PadAt).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {M M' : List (List (List Esm.Closed.Template.Bin64))} {c n j : ℕ}, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ n → (∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n + 1 → Esm.Closed.GeometryAst.vat M' c i = Esm.Closed.GeometryAst.vat M c (if i ≤ j then i else i - 1)) → Esm.Closed.GeometryAst.PadAt M M' c n j

properties.statement: A ring with its first vertex appended after the last (an explicit closing duplicate) is the ring with a zero-length edge inserted at edge position n + 1 (PadAt).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {M M' : List (List (List Esm.Closed.Template.Bin64))} {c n : ℕ}, 1 ≤ n → (∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n + 1 → Esm.Closed.GeometryAst.vat M' c i = Esm.Closed.GeometryAst.vat M c (if i ≤ n then i else 1)) → Esm.Closed.GeometryAst.PadAt M M' c n (n + 1)

properties.statement: On ascending real members, the reference searchsorted(x, members) is 1 plus the number of members below x.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Esm.Closed.Scalar α] [inst_1 : Esm.Closed.Template.RealNaN α] [inst_2 : Esm.Expr.Lits α] [Esm.Expr.Elem α] [Esm.Closed.TemplateAst.ExprLaws α] (a : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 ≤ x2) a → ∀ (x : ℝ), Esm.Closed.searchsorted (Esm.Closed.Template.RealNaN.fin x : α) (List.map Esm.Closed.Template.RealNaN.fin a) = (1 : ℕ) + (List.filter (fun (b : ℝ) => Decidable.decide (b < x)) a).length

properties.statement: When a predicate holds on a prefix of a list and fails on the rest, the bisection partitionPoint returns the number of elements satisfying it.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {β : Type} (p : β → Bool) (S : List β), Esm.Closed.CountAst.PrefixClosed p S → Esm.Closed.CountAst.partitionPoint p S = List.countP p S

properties.statement: For the comparisons <=, <, >=, >, every key list A (any order, NaN keys allowed) and every query q (NaN included): with S the non-NaN keys sorted ascending, the number of keys with a REL q is the bisection count searchCount rel S q, and the number without it is |A| minus that.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Esm.Closed.Scalar α] [inst_1 : Esm.Closed.Template.RealNaN α] [Esm.Closed.CountAst.LtNaN α] [inst_3 : Esm.Expr.Lits α] [Esm.Expr.Elem α] [Esm.Closed.TemplateAst.ExprLaws α] [Esm.Closed.RelationalAst.NaNIs α], ∀ rel ∈ Esm.Closed.CountAst.ordOps, ∀ (A S : List α) (q : α), S.Perm (List.filter (fun (a : α) => !Esm.Closed.Scalar.isNaN a) A) → List.Pairwise (fun (a b : α) => Esm.Closed.Scalar.le a b = Bool.true) S → List.countP (fun (a : α) => Esm.Closed.CountAst.relB rel a q) A = Esm.Closed.CountAst.searchCount rel S q ∧ List.countP (fun (a : α) => !Esm.Closed.CountAst.relB rel a q) A = A.length - Esm.Closed.CountAst.searchCount rel S q
